aoi.rationale: Compact exact four-tile square retaining Riffelhorn faces, Riffelsee, alpine ground cover, loose rock, paths and southern glacier/moraine transitions. No Matterhorn expansion.

coordinate_frame.gltf: X east, Y up, Z south; metres
coordinate_frame.unreal: X east, Y south, Z up; centimetres, unit scale 100, no exaggeration

textures.policy: Unchanged decoded RGB, lossless PNG, no sharpening/resizing; sRGB, uncompressed BGRA, simple-average mips, trilinear, clamped, LOD bias 0, fully resident for captures

black_pixels.handling: Retained unchanged in lossless PNG decode; outside-AOI apron only is edge replicated.

render_settings.lighting: Unlit colour × fixed analytic normal factor (0.65 + 0.35*max(dot(normal,(0.4,-0.3,0.8660254)),0)); no atmospheric or cast-shadow additions
render_settings.geometry: All native cell centres, same triangle diagonal, no Nanite/LOD/collision/smoothing; pixel-centre outer half-cell border not extrapolated

temporal_limitations.classification: Different-year imagery and LiDAR; mixed-acquisition northeast tile; composite terrain update product
implications: Snow/ice and moraines may have moved between 2021/2022 and 2023.
Water level, ground cover, infrastructure and paths can differ.
DSM−DTM may include update/classification/interpolation effects; not object-height truth.
Texture versus geometry discrepancies cannot be attributed solely to resolution.
